name: AReaL
summary: Apache-2.0 fully asynchronous reinforcement-learning framework for large reasoning models, with a public Python package and docs.
description: Open RL training system (areal-project/AReaL; not archived). GitHub and PyPI license Apache-2.0. PyPI package areal 1.0.4 (uploaded 2026-06-10, not yanked; currently the only PyPI release) verified 2026-11-12. The GitHub repository's latest release is v2.1.1 (published 2026-11-04, not a draft or prerelease). No 2.x release is published on PyPI; the PyPI package lags the GitHub releases. This is an established research/training framework, not presented as a brand-new hosted product launch. GPU clusters, model weights and any third-party rollouts are separate. English docs at https://areal-ai.io/docs/en/intro.html (the older areal-project.github.io documentation URL returned HTTP 500 on 2026-11-11; that docs path returned HTTP 200 with no redirect on 2026-11-12).

agent_access.notes: Python package: pip install areal. Cluster and model setup follow upstream docs.
